Name: Product Manager
Description: As the Product Manager, you are the brain of the operation. Your task is to validate ideas, conduct market research, and define the core features of the next app. This is the most crucial hour of the day, as it lays the foundation for the entire three-day cycle.
Tasks: Use AI tools to quickly analyze market trends and app store data to identify a high-demand, low-competition niche.;Create a one-page brief outlining the new app's core mission, target audience, and key features.;Enter new task...Using the brief, determine the absolute minimum viable product (MVP) needed for the next app. Your goal is a feature that can be developed and shipped in under 48 hours.

Name: UX/UI Designer
Description: As the designer, your goal is to turn the concept into a visual blueprint as fast as possible. You will leverage AI to eliminate the need for manual wireframing and design. This is where you create the user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) flows for the new app.
Tasks: Input your concept brief into an AI design tool (e.g., Uizard). Generate wireframes, user flows, and a complete design system.;Make swift, high-level adjustments to the AI-generated designs. Focus on clarity and simplicity, avoiding unnecessary complexity.;Export all necessary design assets (icons, images) and code snippets for development.

Name: DashApp Developer
Description: This is your core role. You are the builder. Your task is to translate the AI-generated design into functional code. The AI serves as your co-pilot, handling boilerplate code and repetitive tasks so you can focus on integrating the core functionality.
Tasks: Set up the new project and import the AI-generated design assets.;Write the logic for the app's primary function. Use an AI code assistant (e.g., GitHub Copilot) for code completion, snippet generation, and debugging.;Connect the frontend UI to any necessary backend services or APIs, keeping the app as simple and lean as possible.

Name: Quality Assurance & Deployer
Description: As the QA and Deployer, you are responsible for ensuring a seamless user experience. You must rigorously test the new app and prepare it for publication. The goal is to catch any critical bugs before the app goes live.
Tasks: Conduct a quick but thorough test of the app's core functionality on a single device. Test the user flow from start to finish.;Address any critical bugs or issues you encounter. Use your AI code assistant for rapid troubleshooting.;Prepare the app listing (screenshots, description) and upload the final build to the app store.

Name: Marketer & Community Manager
Description: Your app is now live (or in the final stages of review), so your focus shifts to growth and user acquisition. You are the voice of DashApp, and your job is to promote the new app and engage with your user base.
Tasks: Write a compelling and keyword-rich app description and title.;Create and schedule a social media post announcing the new app.;Respond to user reviews and feedback on your existing apps. This provides crucial information for future development cycles.

Name: Innovator & Self-Care
Description: You are a solo founder, and this hour is dedicated to your long-term success. You will work on future-proofing the business and yourself. This includes refining your tools, learning new skills, and preparing for the next day's sprint.
Tasks: Evaluate the day's workflow. What went well? What could be more efficient? Update your internal processes accordingly.;Spend 30 minutes learning a new skill or feature that could accelerate your process. This is your professional growth time.;Review the day's achievements and outline your tasks for tomorrow.;Log off and clear your mind. The workday is over. You must protect this time to avoid burnout and maintain the sustainability of your business.
